brief: A free Windows utility by CafeTako that turns the top edge of the screen into a small notch for music, lyrics, focus timers, water, to-dos and files. It should feel calm, light and friendly, never like a dashboard.
criteria: Success: reads at 16 px in the system tray, works in one colour, carries the mascot Sui, and stays distinct from generic 'dynamic island' pills.

concepts.name: Sui in the notch
concepts.idea: The notch itself, with Sui (sui = water) living inside it.
rationale: The pill is the product: the mark is literally the notch at the top of your screen
Sui gives the app a character that also appears as the idle mascot
Droplet sides at exactly 60°, one pill radius, a small-size cut without eyes for 16-32 px
The wordmark's i carries a droplet instead of a dot

recommendation: Sui in the notch: approved direction. Masters, variants, app icon and ICO are delivered in brand/.
next_steps: Run a trademark search on the name and mark before public release
Use the small-size cut for every icon at 32 px and below
Keep Sui Blue for the pill; let user accent colours tint only the app UI
